requirements.requirement: (Supplemental protocol) node3 restart evidence: baseline, ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
requirements.summary: Pre-restart boot_id (ae466ddb...) was captured and the reboot was acknowledged, but every poll for over 30 minutes afterward returned connection reset/timeout, and the fixed after-executor snapshot also shows connection reset for node3. No changed boot identity or recovered state could be observed, so the restart transition for node3 is unverifiable rather than demonstrably broken (node1 and node2 continued responding normally in the same window, suggesting a node3-specific issue rather than a tooling outage).
